intro: Vanquish the Betrayers is a Horde military strike ordered by Gar'Thok in Razor Hill to reclaim Tiragarde Keep from human invaders. Kul Tiran forces under Lieutenant Benedict have reoccupied the stronghold, directly violating the fragile peace between Durotar and Theramore. Eliminating their garrison is critical to securing the eastern coast of the orcish homeland.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Led by Admiral Proudmoore, the humans of Kul Tiras encroached on Durotar, violating the Warchief's pact made with Jaina Proudmoore in order to defeat Archimonde years ago.

The human aggression was repelled and Tiragarde Keep fell. But recently, the Admiral's reserves, led by Lieutenant Benedict, have retaken the keep and once again pose a threat to our homeland. These humans show no respect for diplomacy.
Prove your honor and travel south to Tiragarde Keep to eliminate the human invaders.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have your orders, friend. The safety of Durotar is in question. Complete the task before you or hang your head in shame.
Show your honor and defeat the humans of Tiragarde Keep.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Word of your bravery travels fast, adventurer. Tales of your victory at Tiragarde Keep will be heralded in Orgrimmar.
